text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Gran 
Alegria, she caught sight of a certain 
Umamusume and stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Kris S-senpai, are you heading 
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...It's a science museum.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Commencing... refreshing phase.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh, at the science museum!? Huh~... 
Hmmmm~...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Um, may I join you? I'm curious to see 
what kind of change of pace this is!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ ――I'd say it's just boring, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, we won't know unless we go 
and see! Please, Senpai!
choice_data_list: Can I ask something of you too?
May I ask a favor of you as well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: …………Got it. ――If you're going that far.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"‘Wonders of Water’ and ‘Let's Experiment 
with Water!’... This science museum is 
completely packed with water exhibits!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—That's it. Look over there... That 
exhibit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The Birth of Natural Mineral Water." 
...I've watched this—countless times 
already.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—It begins with the sea. Turning to 
rain... connecting to the forest...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Filtered through the strata... it becomes 
pure, famous spring water.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I picture it in my head. ――I visualize 
it... continuously, forever."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it... I'm relaxed. —My 
heart is... deeply at peace."
choice_data_list:
I-I see... So it's about natural spring 
water...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—It's... hard to understand, isn't it? 
This is... a sensation... unique to me..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Let's—change locations. To somewhere... 
Gran—can enjoy—even more.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Don't mind me at all! I want to stay here 
a little longer!
choice_data_list: Is it because it calms you down?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No! I still don't really understand how 
you refresh your mind, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
However, Kris S-senpai just now... had 
such a gentle look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I figured it must be something special. 
That's why I didn't want to get in the 
way!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............ ――Is that... alright?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Thanks. ...You have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No, this is the least I can do! After all, 
it's something important to you, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that's awesome. Sticking to your 
own rules, no matter what... It's really 
cool!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria has always followed her own 
unique "My Rules" without any hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's because she genuinely, 
wholeheartedly believes in the value that 
'having personal rules enriches oneself.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Which is precisely why. Precisely 
because I cherish my own values—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She could respect any values held by 
others. As if it were the most natural 
thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'll try thinking about spring 
water too! ...What about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Maybe I'll let my thoughts wander a bit 
too.
Maybe I'll reflect on my feelings too.
I'll try studying more about water!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'll try thinking about spring 
water too! ...What about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Maybe I'll let my thoughts wander a bit 
too.
Maybe I'll reflect on my feelings too.
I'll try studying more about water!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Starting as rain and traveling all 
the way into everyone's hands... It's like 
a journey, so romantic!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if we can fully understand 
how Kris S-senpai feels, but... we can 
still help her get a good change of pace 
in our own way!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Respecting yourself as well as others... 
Assertiveness, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"My utmost respect to you. —You really are 
amazing, Gran."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that sounds great too! Seems like 
there'd be so much to learn!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own way of having fun, 
after all. I'm sure there's a perfect way 
for you to spend your time, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—If needed... I too shall 
offer—commentary.
